mainTopic: Whether מעילה applies to an עולת העוף offered below the line as a חטאת, and whether such a bird actually turns into a different offering.
overview: The משנה deals with a bird burnt offering (עולת העוף) that the כהן offered below the red line, in the manner and for the sake of a bird sin offering (חטאת העוף). רבי אליעזר says one is still liable for מעילה with it, and רבי יהושע says one is not. רבי אליעזר brings proofs from most-sacred offerings slaughtered as lesser offerings, and from an אשם slaughtered as a שלמים. רבי יהושע rejects each one by showing the bird changed more: its name, its place, and its procedure. רבא asks why רבי אליעזר did not answer with an אשם that also had a change of owner. He concludes that רבי אליעזר accepted רבי יהושע's reasoning: such a bird actually becomes a חטאת העוף once one סימן is pinched. The גמרא then asks whether a bird חטאת done as an עולה should likewise become an עולה. One answer says yes, reading רבי בנאה as speaking about the whole משנה. רב אשי disagrees and explains why the switch works only from עולה to חטאת. The amud ends by quoting רבי יהושע's rule again under the heading גופא, to begin discussing it directly.

steps.title: רבי אליעזר's proof from most-sacred offerings slaughtered as lesser offerings
steps.stepSummary: רבי אליעזר argues that changing an offering's designation to something without מעילה does not cancel its מעילה. He proves this from קדשי קדשים slaughtered in the south as קדשים קלים, which still carry מעילה.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי אליעזר said to him: Look at most-sacred offerings that someone slaughtered in the south of the courtyard, for the sake of lesser offerings. They prove my point. There, he changed their name to something that has no מעילה, and yet one is still liable for misusing them. So don't be surprised about the burnt offering either. Even though he changed its name to something with no מעילה, one is still liable for misusing it!
steps.whatsHappening: רבי אליעזר defends his ruling. He brings a case where an offering was switched to a type that has no מעילה, and still the מעילה stays.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי יהושע's point was that the עולת העוף was turned into a חטאת העוף, which has no מעילה, so the מעילה should disappear. רבי אליעזר answers that changing the name does not remove מעילה. Most-sacred offerings switched to lesser ones keep their מעילה, so the bird עולה should keep it too.

keyTerms.meaning: Offerings of the most sacred level (like עולה, חטאת, אשם), which must be slaughtered in the north
Offerings of lesser sanctity (like שלמים), which may be slaughtered anywhere in the courtyard
The sin of using sacred property for personal benefit
They will prove it, a standard way of pointing to a test case
Do not be surprised

phrases.english: Rabbi Eliezer said to him:
But look at most-sacred offerings that one slaughtered in the south
phrases.notes: Most-sacred offerings belong in the north. The south is only the right place for lesser offerings.

phrases.english: and slaughtered them for the sake of lesser-sanctity offerings; they will prove it
for there he changed their name
to something that has no misuse liability,
and yet one is liable for misusing them;

phrases.aramaic: אַף אַתָּה אַל תִּתְמַהּ עַל הָעוֹלָה –
phrases.english: you too should not be surprised about the burnt offering
that even though he changed its name

phrases.aramaic: לְדָבָר שֶׁאֵין בּוֹ מְעִילָה, שֶׁיִּמְעֲלוּ בָּהּ!
phrases.english: to something that has no misuse liability, one is still liable for misusing it!
phrases.notes: "Something with no misuse" here is the bird חטאת, which the כהנים eat.

steps.triggerLanguage: וַהֲרֵי קׇדְשֵׁי קָדָשִׁים שֶׁשְּׁחָטָן בַּדָּרוֹם וּשְׁחָטָן לְשֵׁם קֳדָשִׁים קַלִּים יוֹכִיחוּ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues the debate in the משנה with a new proof from רבי אליעזר.
steps.raayaObject: That an עולת העוף offered as a חטאת העוף still carries מעילה.
steps.raayaSupportSource: קדשי קדשים slaughtered in the south as קדשים קלים still carry מעילה even though their name was changed.

steps.title: רבי יהושע rejects the proof: lesser offerings still have forbidden parts
steps.stepSummary: רבי יהושע says the comparison fails. קדשים קלים still have parts burned on the מזבח, so they partly carry מעילה. A חטאת העוף is fully eaten, so it has no such parts.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי יהושע said to him: No. You can say that about most-sacred offerings slaughtered in the south as lesser offerings, because there he changed them into something that has both forbidden and permitted parts. Can you say the same about the burnt offering, where he changed it into something that is entirely permitted?!
steps.whatsHappening: רבי יהושע pushes back on רבי אליעזר's proof. He shows a difference between the two cases.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Lesser offerings are not completely free of מעילה. Their altar portions (אימורים) are forbidden for personal use. A bird חטאת is eaten entirely by the כהנים, with nothing for the מזבח. So turning a bird עולה into a bird חטאת removes the forbidden element completely, which the other case does not.

keyTerms.meaning: Forbidden and permitted parts both present in one offering
Entirely permitted, with nothing reserved for the מזבח
No, if you said, the standard opening for rejecting a comparison
Will you say? A question that means: surely not

phrases.english: Rabbi Yehoshua said to him: No;
if you said this about most-sacred offerings
that one slaughtered in the south
and slaughtered for the sake of lesser-sanctity offerings
that is because he changed their name
to something that has both forbidden and permitted parts;
phrases.notes: The meat of lesser offerings is permitted, but the parts burned on the מזבח are forbidden.

phrases.english: will you say the same about the burnt offering
where he changed its name
to something that is entirely permitted?!
phrases.notes: A bird חטאת is eaten completely by the כהנים. None of it goes on the מזבח.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר לוֹ רַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ: לֹא; אִם אָמַרְתָּ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Directly rejects the proof brought in step 1.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: Rejects only the comparison to קדשי קדשים made into קדשים קלים, not רבי אליעזר's general principle.
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: The proof case still has a forbidden element (אימורים), while a חטאת העוף is entirely permitted.

steps.title: In a ברייתא, רבי אליעזר brings a proof from a guilt offering slaughtered as a peace offering
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא quotes a ברייתא with another argument from רבי אליעזר. An אשם slaughtered in the north as a שלמים still carries מעילה even though its name changed, so the bird עולה should too.
steps.simpleTranslation: גמרא: It was taught in a ברייתא: רבי אליעזר said to רבי יהושע: A guilt offering that one slaughtered in the north for the sake of a peace offering proves my point. He changed its name, and yet one is liable for misusing it. So you too should not be surprised about the burnt offering. Even though he changed its name, one is still liable for misusing it.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא begins by quoting a ברייתא that adds another round to the debate. רבי אליעזר brings a new proof case.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In the ברייתא's version of the debate, רבי אליעזר brings a different proof. The אשם was slaughtered in the north, a proper place for it, and only its name was changed to a שלמים. Since it still keeps its מעילה, he argues that a change of name alone does not remove מעילה.

keyTerms.meaning: Guilt offering, a most-sacred offering slaughtered in the north
Peace offering, a lesser offering
The north side of the courtyard, required for most-sacred offerings

steps.whyThisMatters: It shows רבי אליעזר's real claim is that a change of name by itself never cancels מעילה.

phrases.english: GEMARA: It was taught in a baraita:

phrases.aramaic: אָמַר לוֹ רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר לְרַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ:
phrases.english: Rabbi Eliezer said to Rabbi Yehoshua:
A guilt offering that one slaughtered in the north
for the sake of a peace offering will prove it
for he changed its name, and yet one is liable for misusing it;

phrases.aramaic: וְאַף אַתָּה אַל תִּתְמַהּ עַל הָעוֹלָה –
phrases.english: and you too should not be surprised about the burnt offering

phrases.aramaic: שֶׁאַף עַל פִּי שֶׁשִּׁינָּה אֶת שְׁמָהּ,
phrases.english: that even though he changed its name,
one is still liable for misusing it.

steps.triggerLanguage: תַּנְיָא, אָמַר לוֹ רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר לְרַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ: אָשָׁם שֶׁשְּׁחָטוֹ בַּצָּפוֹן לְשֵׁם שְׁלָמִים יוֹכִיחַ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Opens the גמרא with a ברייתא that adds a further proof from רבי אליעזר.
steps.raayaObject: That an עולת העוף offered as a חטאת העוף still carries מעילה.
steps.raayaSupportSource: An אשם slaughtered in the north as a שלמים still carries מעילה.

steps.title: רבי יהושע rejects the guilt offering proof: the bird offering also changed its place
steps.stepSummary: רבי יהושע answers that the אשם only changed its name, not its place, since both אשם and שלמים may be slaughtered in the north. The bird עולה changed both its name and its place.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי יהושע said to him: No. You can say that about a guilt offering, because even though he changed its name, he did not change its place. Can you say the same about the burnt offering, where he changed its name and also changed its place?!
steps.whatsHappening: רבי יהושע rejects the new proof by showing another difference between the cases.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The north is a proper place for both an אשם and a שלמים, so slaughtering there changed only the name. A bird עולה belongs above the red line, and a bird חטאת is done below it. So this offering changed both its name and its place, which is a bigger change. That bigger change can remove its מעילה.

keyTerms.meaning: Its place, the spot where the offering is supposed to be done
He changed its name, meaning he offered it under a different type of offering

steps.whatToRemember: רבי יהושע holds that a bird עולה turned into a bird חטאת loses its מעילה, because it changed both its name and its place, and into something entirely permitted. רבי אליעזר's proofs each involve a smaller change.

phrases.english: Rabbi Yehoshua said to him: No;
if you said this about a guilt offering
that is because even if he changed its name
he did not change its place;
phrases.notes: The north works for both an אשם and a שלמים, so the location was still correct.

phrases.english: will you say the same about the burnt offering

phrases.aramaic: שֶׁשִּׁינָּה אֶת שְׁמָהּ וְשִׁינָּה אֶת מְקוֹמָהּ?!
phrases.english: where he changed its name and also changed its place?!
phrases.notes: A bird עולה is done above the red line. Here it was done below it, like a bird חטאת.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר לוֹ רַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ: לֹא; אִם אָמַרְתָּ בְּאָשָׁם
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Directly rejects the proof brought in step 3.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: Rejects the comparison to an אשם slaughtered as a שלמים.
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: The אשם kept its proper place, while the bird עולה changed both its name and its place.

steps.title: An אשם slaughtered in the south as a שלמים
steps.stepSummary: רבי אליעזר brings a new case. An אשם slaughtered in the south for the sake of a שלמים changes both its name and its place, yet it still carries מעילה. So the bird עולה should carry מעילה too.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי אליעזר said to him: Let an אשם that was slaughtered in the south as a שלמים prove it. There, both its name and its place were changed, and still there is מעילה. So do not be surprised about the bird עולה. Even though its name and its place were changed, there is still מעילה.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי אליעזר answers רבי יהושע's last objection with a case where both the name and the place were changed.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In step 4, רבי יהושע said the earlier אשם case changed only its name, not its place. So רבי אליעזר now picks an אשם slaughtered in the south, which is the wrong place for an אשם. That case changes both name and place, just like the bird עולה, and it still keeps מעילה.

keyTerms.meaning: The south side of the עזרה. An אשם must be slaughtered in the north, so the south is the wrong place for it.
Will prove it. Used to bring a case that disproves the other side's distinction.
Do not be surprised.
He changed its place, meaning it was offered in a location not meant for it.

phrases.english: Rabbi Eliezer said to him:

phrases.aramaic: אָשָׁם שֶׁשְּׁחָטוֹ בַּדָּרוֹם לְשֵׁם שְׁלָמִים יוֹכִיחַ –
phrases.english: An אשם that one slaughtered in the south for the sake of a שלמים will prove it,
phrases.notes: A שלמים may be slaughtered anywhere in the עזרה, but an אשם belongs in the north. So for an אשם, the south is the wrong place.

phrases.aramaic: שֶׁשִּׁינָּה אֶת שְׁמוֹ וְשִׁינָּה אֶת מְקוֹמוֹ,
phrases.english: since he changed its name and changed its place,
and still one is liable for מעילה with it.

phrases.aramaic: אַף אַתָּה אַל תִּתְמַהּ עַל הָעוֹלָה –
phrases.english: So you too, do not be surprised about the עולה,

phrases.aramaic: שֶׁאַף עַל פִּי שֶׁשִּׁינָּה אֶת שְׁמָהּ
phrases.english: that even though he changed its name
and changed its place, one is liable for מעילה with it.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר לוֹ רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר: אָשָׁם שֶׁשְּׁחָטוֹ בַּדָּרוֹם לְשֵׁם שְׁלָמִים יוֹכִיחַ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Repairs the proof from step 3 so that it gets past רבי יהושע's name-versus-place distinction in step 4.
steps.raayaObject: A bird עולה offered below the line as a חטאת still carries מעילה.
steps.raayaSupportSource: An אשם slaughtered in the south as a שלמים, which changed both name and place and still carries מעילה.

steps.title: The אשם kept its procedure but the bird עולה did not
steps.stepSummary: רבי יהושע rejects the proof. The אשם changed its name and place but not its procedure. The bird עולה changed its name, its place, and its procedure.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי יהושע said to him: No. You can say this about an אשם, which changed its name and its place but not its procedure. Can you say the same about an עולה, which changed its name and its procedure, and also changed its place?
steps.whatsHappening: רבי יהושע points to a third difference that the אשם case does not have.
steps.deeperAnalysis: An אשם slaughtered as a שלמים is still offered with basically the same steps. The bird עולה was done fully with the steps of a חטאת. That makes three changes instead of two, so the אשם case cannot prove anything about the bird.

keyTerms.meaning: Its procedure, meaning the actual steps used to offer it.
"No, if you say..." A standard way to open a rejection by showing the cases differ.
"Can you say?" Asked as a challenge, meaning you cannot.

phrases.english: Rabbi Yehoshua said to him: No.
If you say this about an אשם,

phrases.aramaic: שֶׁשִּׁינָּה אֶת שְׁמוֹ וְשִׁינָּה אֶת מְקוֹמוֹ,
phrases.english: where he changed its name and changed its place
but did not change its procedure,
will you say it about an עולה,
where he changed its name and its procedure,
and also changed its place?!

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר לוֹ רַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ: לֹא; אִם אָמַרְתָּ בְּאָשָׁם
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects the proof in step 5 by pointing to a difference in procedure.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: Rejects the comparison between the אשם and the bird עולה.
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: The אשם kept its procedure, while the bird עולה changed its procedure as well. It has three changes, not two.

steps.title: Why not an אשם with a change of owner too?
steps.stepSummary: רבא asks why רבי אליעזר did not reply with an אשם slaughtered in the south, as a שלמים, and for a different owner. That case would have all three changes.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבא said: Let רבי אליעזר answer him with an אשם slaughtered in the south as a שלמים with a change of owner. There he changed its name, its place, and its procedure, and it still carries מעילה!
steps.whatsHappening: רבא steps in and asks why the debate stopped. He suggests a reply רבי אליעזר seemingly could have given. This sets up the next step, which explains why he did not give it.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבא counts the change of owner as a third change, a change in its procedure. That would match all three of the bird's changes, and such an אשם still carries מעילה. So רבי אליעזר's silence needs an explanation.

keyTerms.meaning: "Let him say to him." Asks why a possible answer was not given.
A change of owner, meaning the animal was slaughtered for someone other than its real owner.

phrases.english: Rava said: But let him say to him:
phrases.notes: He means: why didn't רבי אליעזר answer רבי יהושע this way?

phrases.english: An אשם that one slaughtered in the south for the sake of a שלמים
with a change of owner,

phrases.aramaic: שֶׁשִּׁינָּה אֶת שְׁמוֹ, וְשִׁינָּה אֶת מְקוֹמוֹ,
phrases.english: where he changed its name and changed its place
and changed its procedure!
phrases.notes: The words "and it still carries מעילה" are left out but assumed.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Questions why רבי אליעזר accepted the rejection in step 6 when a further reply seemed to be available.
steps.kashyaTarget: The ending of the ברייתא, where רבי אליעזר gives no reply.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: An אשם with a change of owner would have all three changes and still carry מעילה, so רבי אליעזר seemingly had an answer.

steps.title: רבי אליעזר accepted that the bird becomes a חטאת העוף
steps.stepSummary: רבא concludes from רבי אליעזר's silence that he accepted רבי יהושע's reasoning. As רב אדא בר אהבה reports, a bird עולה done fully as a חטאת turns into a חטאת העוף once one סימן is cut.
steps.simpleTranslation: Since he did not say this to him, learn from it that רבי אליעזר came around to רבי יהושע's reasoning. As רב אדא בר אהבה said: רבי יהושע used to say that a bird עולה done below the line, with the procedure of a חטאת and for the sake of a חטאת, is drawn after the חטאת once one סימן is pinched, and it becomes a חטאת העוף.
steps.whatsHappening: רבא answers his own question. רבי אליעזר stayed quiet because he understood and accepted רבי יהושע's real point.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי יהושע's point was not just a count of changes. Once the bird is done fully as a חטאת, it actually turns into a חטאת העוף. A חטאת העוף is eaten and has no מעילה. An אשם, even with many changes, stays an אשם, so no אשם case could disprove this.

keyTerms.meaning: Since he did not say this to him.
He came down to his reasoning, meaning he understood and accepted the other side's logic.
Pinched. The way a bird offering is killed, by cutting the neck with the כהן's fingernail.
One of the two organs cut in slaughter, the windpipe or the food pipe.
Is drawn after, meaning it moves over and takes on the new status.

steps.whatToRemember: A bird עולה done fully as a חטאת, below the line and for the sake of a חטאת, does not just get a wrong name. It actually becomes a חטאת העוף. That is why the אשם cases could not prove that it keeps מעילה.
steps.confusionAlert: Do not read the ending as רבי אליעזר simply running out of answers. רבא's point is that he truly understood that the bird changes its identity, which an אשם never does.
steps.whyThisMatters: This explains רבי יהושע's view in the debate: מעילה is gone because the bird has become a different offering, not only because of how many things were changed.

phrases.aramaic: מִדְּלָא קָאָמַר לֵיהּ הָכִי, שְׁמַע מִינַּהּ:
phrases.english: Since he did not say this to him, learn from it:

phrases.aramaic: נְחֵית רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר לְטַעְמֵיהּ דְּרַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ –
phrases.english: Rabbi Eliezer came around to Rabbi Yehoshua's reasoning,
as Rav Adda bar Ahava said:
Rabbi Yehoshua used to say:
A bird עולה that one offered below
phrases.notes: Below the red line on the מזבח, where a bird חטאת is done.

phrases.english: with the procedure of a חטאת, for the sake of a חטאת,
once he pinched one סימן in it,
it is drawn after it and becomes a bird חטאת.

steps.triggerLanguage: מִדְּלָא קָאָמַר לֵיהּ הָכִי, שְׁמַע מִינַּהּ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers רבא's question in step 7 by explaining רבי אליעזר's silence.
steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: רבי אליעזר accepted that a bird עולה done fully as a חטאת becomes a חטאת העוף, so the אשם cases are no proof that it keeps מעילה.

steps.title: Should a bird sin offering also turn into a burnt offering?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא challenges: if a bird עולה turns into a חטאת, then a חטאת העוף done above the line as an עולה should turn into an עולת העוף once one סימן is cut.
steps.simpleTranslation: If so, then a bird חטאת that someone did above the line in the way of an עולה should also, from the moment he pinches one סימן, slide over and become a bird עולה!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא takes the rule just learned and flips it around. It asks whether the opposite case should work the same way.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The rule was that a bird עולה, done in every way like a חטאת, becomes a חטאת after one סימן. By the same logic, a חטאת done in every way like an עולה should become an עולה. The גמרא presents this as a challenge, because it sounds strange to say that a חטאת can turn into an עולה.

keyTerms.meaning: If so (if what you just said is true)
A bird sin offering
Above the red line on the altar, where an עולה's blood belongs
One of the two signs cut when killing a bird: the windpipe or the food pipe
It should be pulled over, meaning it should shift into a new status

phrases.english: If so, a bird sin offering too –
that one did above, according to the procedure of a burnt offering;
phrases.notes: 'Above' means above the red line that runs around the middle of the altar.

phrases.english: from when he pinches one סימן in it,
it should be drawn over and become a bird burnt offering!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Takes the conclusion of step 8 and asks whether it should also work in reverse.
steps.kashyaTarget: The rule from step 8 that a bird עולה done fully as a חטאת becomes a חטאת העוף.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: If the rule is based on the bird being done completely in the other offering's way, the same reasoning should let a חטאת done completely as an עולה become an עולה.

steps.title: רבי בנאה seems to limit the rule to the case in the משנה
steps.stepSummary: If you say the reverse really does work, that seems to clash with רבי יוחנן quoting רבי בנאה, who said 'this is the presentation of the משנה.' That seems to mean the rule applies only to the case stated in the משנה.
steps.simpleTranslation: And if you will say that yes, it really is so, but רבי יוחנן said in the name of רבי בנאה: 'This is the presentation of the משנה!' Does that not mean: this is the presentation, and nothing more?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא blocks the easy way out of the challenge, which would be to simply agree that a חטאת becomes an עולה. It quotes רבי בנאה to argue that the rule is limited to the משנה's case.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Someone might answer step 9 by saying that a חטאת really does become an עולה. The גמרא argues against this from רבי בנאה's words. It reads 'this is the presentation of the משנה' as limiting: the rule covers only the עולה done as a חטאת, and nothing beyond it.

keyTerms.meaning: And if you will say
Yes, it really is so
Presentation, meaning the correct way the משנה is laid out
And nothing more

phrases.english: And if you will say, indeed it is so,

phrases.aramaic: וְהָא אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן מִשּׁוּם רַבִּי בְּנָאָה:
phrases.english: but didn't Rabbi Yochanan say in the name of Rabbi Bena'a:
this is the presentation of the mishnah!

phrases.aramaic: מַאי, לָאו כָּךְ הִיא הַצָּעָה – וְתוּ לָא?
phrases.english: What, is it not: this is the presentation, and nothing more?
phrases.notes: He is saying the rule fits only the exact case in the משנה, the עולה done as a חטאת.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְכִי תֵּימָא הָכִי נָמֵי, וְהָא אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן מִשּׁוּם רַבִּי בְּנָאָה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Closes off the possible reply to step 9 that the reverse case really does work.
steps.kashyaTarget: The possible reply that a חטאת העוף done as an עולה really does become an עולת העוף.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: רבי בנאה's statement seems to limit רבי יהושע's rule to the single case in the משנה, so it cannot be stretched to the reverse case.

steps.title: No, רבי בנאה meant the whole משנה
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא rejects the proof. רבי בנאה meant that this is the presentation of the entire משנה, including the reverse case.
steps.simpleTranslation: No. He meant: this is the presentation of the whole משנה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא pushes back on step 10's reading of רבי בנאה. His words were not limiting the rule.
steps.deeperAnalysis: 'This is the presentation' is now read as covering every case in the משנה, including a חטאת done fully as an עולה. So the גמרא answers step 9 by accepting it: the reverse case really does become an עולת העוף. רב אשי, in the next step, disagrees with this answer.

keyTerms.meaning: The entire משנה

phrases.aramaic: לָא; כָּךְ הַצָּעָה שֶׁל כּוּלָּהּ מִשְׁנָה.
phrases.english: No; this is the presentation of the entire mishnah.

steps.triggerLanguage: לָא; כָּךְ הַצָּעָה שֶׁל כּוּלָּהּ מִשְׁנָה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects the limiting reading of רבי בנאה given in step 10.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: Rejects the limiting reading of רבי בנאה. This leaves standing the reply to step 9 that the reverse case really does become an עולת העוף.
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: Step 10 read 'this is the presentation' as limiting, but it can just as easily mean the presentation of the whole משנה.

steps.title: רב אשי: why a burnt offering below the line becomes a sin offering
steps.stepSummary: רב אשי explains the first direction. Below the line, an עולת העוף cannot exist at all. So once one סימן is cut, the bird slides smoothly into being a חטאת העוף.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב אשי said: It makes sense for a bird עולה done below the line in the way of a חטאת, for the sake of a חטאת. This one becomes valid with one סימן and that one becomes valid with two סימנים, and there is no bird עולה below the line. So once he pinched one סימן, it is drawn over and becomes a bird חטאת.
steps.whatsHappening: רב אשי starts a new answer to the challenge in step 9. First he explains why the original case works.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A חטאת העוף is complete with one סימן, while an עולת העוף needs two. Below the line there is no such thing as a valid עולה. So when one סימן is cut there for the sake of a חטאת, nothing has to be 'ruined' as an עולה. The bird simply becomes a finished חטאת.

keyTerms.meaning: It makes sense (granted) for one case, setting up a contrast with the next
Below the red line on the altar, where a bird חטאת's blood belongs
What makes it valid
It does not exist
A bird burnt offering

phrases.english: Rav Ashi said:
Granted, a bird burnt offering that one did below
according to the procedure of a sin offering, for the sake of a sin offering –
since this one is made valid with one סימן
and that one is made valid with two סימנים;
phrases.notes: 'This one' is the חטאת, which needs one סימן. 'That one' is the עולה, which needs both.

phrases.english: and a bird burnt offering below does not exist;
once he pinched one סימן in it –
it is drawn over and becomes a bird sin offering.

steps.triggerLanguage: רַב אָשֵׁי אָמַר: בִּשְׁלָמָא עוֹלַת הָעוֹף
steps.relationToPreviousStep: רב אשי gives a different answer to step 9. Unlike step 11, he holds that the reverse case does not work, and he begins by explaining why the original direction does.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The two directions look exactly alike, so a חטאת done as an עולה should become an עולה.
steps.terutzMaskana: The עולה case works because below the line an עולה cannot exist, so one סימן smoothly completes it as a חטאת.

steps.title: רב אשי: why a sin offering cannot become a burnt offering
steps.stepSummary: A bird חטאת is valid anywhere on the altar. So the first סימן cut for the sake of an עולה already disqualifies it, and a disqualified bird cannot later turn into an עולה.
steps.simpleTranslation: But a bird חטאת is different. The Master said that pinching is valid anywhere on the altar. So as soon as he pinched one סימן, it became disqualified. When he then pinches the other סימן, how can it be drawn over and become a bird עולה?
steps.whatsHappening: רב אשי finishes his answer by showing why the reverse case from step 9 does not work.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Above the line is still a valid place for a חטאת, so the bird was a real, working חטאת when the first סימן was cut. Cutting it for the sake of an עולה ruins it as a חטאת right away. By the time the second סימן is cut, it is already a disqualified bird and has nothing left to transform from. This is why רבי יהושע's rule works only in one direction.

keyTerms.meaning: But, introducing the case that is different
Pinching, killing a bird by cutting with the כהן's fingernail
It became disqualified
The other one

steps.whatToRemember: According to רב אשי, רבי יהושע's switch works only from עולה to חטאת. Below the line an עולה cannot exist, so one סימן finishes the bird as a חטאת. A חטאת is valid anywhere on the altar, so the first wrong cut ruins it before it could ever become an עולה. The first answer, in step 11, held that the switch works both ways.
steps.confusionAlert: Do not think the problem is the place. Above the line is fine for a חטאת. The problem is that the first סימן was cut for the sake of an עולה, and that alone disqualifies a חטאת.
steps.whyThisMatters: It shows that the two cases only look like mirror images. Whether a bird can switch status depends on whether it was already disqualified before the switch could happen.

phrases.english: But a bird sin offering,
since the Master said:
pinching is valid in every place;
phrases.notes: For a bird חטאת, pinching works anywhere on the altar, above or below the line.

phrases.aramaic: מִכִּי מָלֵק בַּהּ סִימָן אֶחָד – אִיפַּסְלָא;
phrases.english: from when he pinched one סימן in it, it became disqualified;
phrases.notes: It is disqualified because that first סימן was cut for the sake of an עולה, not a חטאת.

phrases.english: when he then pinches the other סימן –
how can it be drawn over and become a bird burnt offering?

steps.triggerLanguage: אֶלָּא חַטַּאת הָעוֹף, כֵּיוָן דְּאָמַר מָר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Completes רב אשי's distinction begun in step 12 by explaining the reverse case.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: A חטאת done fully as an עולה should become an עולה, just as an עולה done fully as a חטאת becomes a חטאת.
steps.terutzMaskana: A חטאת is valid anywhere on the altar, so the first סימן cut for the sake of an עולה disqualifies it, and it can no longer switch.
steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: According to רב אשי, the challenge of step 9 is answered by a distinction. The bird עולה becomes a חטאת, but a bird חטאת does not become an עולה. This differs from the answer in step 11.

steps.title: Restating רבי יהושע's rule about a bird burnt offering that becomes a sin offering
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא opens with גופא and quotes in full רב אדא בר אהבה's report of רבי יהושע's rule. An עולת העוף offered below the line as a חטאת becomes a חטאת העוף once one סימן is cut.
steps.simpleTranslation: Now to the statement itself. רב אדא בר אהבה said that רבי יהושע used to say: suppose someone took a bird עולה and offered it below the red line. He did it the way a חטאת is done and for the sake of a חטאת. Once he has pinched one סימן, the bird is drawn over and becomes a bird חטאת.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא goes back to quote, word for word, the statement of רבי יהושע that it has been discussing. This sets up a fresh, direct discussion of that statement.
steps.deeperAnalysis: This is the rule that steps 9–13 were arguing about. Here it is laid out in full. The bird was meant to be an עולה, but three things all point toward a חטאת: the place (below the line), the method (like a חטאת), and the intention (for a חטאת). Once one סימן is cut, the bird switches over and becomes a חטאת העוף.

keyTerms.meaning: "The matter itself." The גמרא is returning to quote a statement in full so it can discuss it.
A bird burnt offering. Its service is done above the red line on the altar.
Below the red line on the altar. This is the place where a bird חטאת is done.
He pinched. A bird offering is killed by the כהן's fingernail, not with a knife.
It is drawn over. The bird slides from one status into the other.

steps.confusionAlert: This is not a new opinion. It is the same rule the previous steps were debating, now quoted in full under the heading גופא.

phrases.english: The matter itself:
phrases.notes: The גמרא goes back to quote an earlier statement in full, so it can look at it closely.

phrases.english: Rav Adda bar Ahava said:
Rabbi Yehoshua would say:
A bird burnt offering that one performed below
phrases.notes: "Below" means below the red line around the middle of the altar.

phrases.english: like the procedure of a sin offering, for the sake of a sin offering —
once he pinched one siman in it,
it is drawn over and becomes a bird sin offering.

steps.triggerLanguage: גּוּפָא – אָמַר רַב אַדָּא בַּר אַהֲבָה, אוֹמֵר הָיָה רַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: After resolving the challenges in steps 9–13, the גמרא returns with גופא to quote the original statement in full and begin examining it directly.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: An עולת העוף offered below the line, in the manner of a חטאת and for the sake of a חטאת, becomes a חטאת העוף once one סימן is pinched.
